points.point: Failed to upload stream to Supabase error meaning
points.sentence: The media file could not be saved to storage.

points.point: Google Drive /view link as the cause and fix
points.sentence: If using Google Drive, use a direct download link, not a /view link.

verdict.reason: This entry covers the exact Supabase upload error and says to use a direct download link instead of a Google Drive /view link.
